tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

I didn't look anything up in PropBank. Points where I made a judgement call:

- **Timing:** I put 扩展 (expanding the monitoring plan) and 恢复 (resuming imports) after the main events because they are future events (将, 会). I linked 目前 ("currently") to the document creation time and placed the not-knowing during it. I put 处理 (treating the water) before 排海 (discharging it).
- **Certainty:** Kishida is the speaker, so he is the one sure of what he says. His not knowing is full-negative. Since he doesn't know, the resumption below it is `unspecified`. The monitoring is also `unspecified` because it sits under a plan.
- **Coreference:** I linked Kishida's "treated water" (s3w) to sentence 2's "nuclear-contaminated water" (s2s3) as the same water under a different name. I also linked his aquatic products (s3s2) to sentence 2's "products that meet the standard" (s2s4) as the same entity. `:subset-of` would also be a defensible choice for that pair. Kishida himself has no earlier mention, so he gets no link.
- **Not annotated:** I treated `contrast-91` as a link between clauses rather than an event, so it has no relations.
